title: Global bifurcation for steady viscous roll waves on an incline
summary: We construct a branch of travelling periodic `roll wave' solutions to the free-boundary incompressible Navier--Stokes equations on an inclined plane in two dimensions. These solutions bifurcate from a parallel shear flow, under natural assumptions on the related Orr--Sommerfeld equation. Using techniques from analytic global bifurcation theory, we extend the local branch to a global curve of solutions.
